name: Mint

schedule.notes: Plant in a buried pot or a contained bed — it spreads aggressively by runners.
Pinch tips frequently to keep bushy and prevent flowering.

harvest.cues: Cut whole stems 1 in above the soil — regrows quickly. Best flavor just before flowering.
harvest.storageNotes: Stems in a jar of water at room temp 1 week. Dries well; freeze in cubes for cocktails.

varieties.name: Spearmint
varieties.notes: The standard for cooking, mojitos, tabbouleh.

varieties.name: Peppermint
varieties.notes: Higher menthol. Best for tea and desserts.

varieties.name: Chocolate Mint
varieties.notes: Faint cocoa-mint aroma. Great in ice cream and chocolate desserts.

notes: Always contain — runners will take over a bed in two seasons. Bury a 12 in pot with rim above ground, or use a deep planter. Cut hard after flowering to refresh.
